claim_text: A tomb being dug up near Iran and Turkey containing tablets or artefacts that will be a shock about the Bible and draw many to Jesus, which he hopes concerns Noah's ark, with military placed around the site because they did not want the material brought up.
quote: there's some kind of tablets or some kind of artifact in there
falsify_match: An excavation producing inscribed tablets that changes public understanding of the Bible.
falsify_miss: No such find. He says himself he does not know what it is and hopes it is the ark.

claim_text: The find said to shake the Muslim world, with scans already done and the measurements described as perfect, and speculation about bones or tablets.
quote: it's going to shake the Muslims
falsify_match: A verified ark discovery with a public effect on Muslim opinion.
falsify_miss: The Durupinar site has been scanned and disputed for decades; the perfect measurements claim comes from that existing material.

claim_text: Ruth Bader Ginsburg seen holding the Bill of Rights as stone tablets like the Ten Commandments, with the First Amendment carved bold, about to fall out of her fingers, and Epstein walking up beside her looking at them with a smirk while the rest of the Supreme Court stands behind.
quote: they were about to fall out of her hands
falsify_match: A Supreme Court ruling narrowing the First Amendment, with an Epstein-linked scandal touching the court.
falsify_miss: Neither. Both figures are dead, which he notes, so the scene is emblematic rather than predictive.

claim_text: One First Amendment seen dirty and cobwebbed but held stable by a black plate, the other wrapped in a spider's cocoon, with the spider gazing at Canada, France, Germany, England and Australia, and the word that First Amendment rights are in danger by the Supreme Court, and that what is embraced will push it away.
quote: Your First Amendment rights are in danger by the Supreme Court
falsify_match: A Supreme Court decision materially narrowing free speech protection.
falsify_miss: No such decision. Naming the court as the source is more specific than the usual free speech material.

claim_text: The New York mayor seen behind a desk being rebellious and defiant and polished to speak louder for the Democrats, his voice magnified as if on a loudspeaker, and lighting the Empire State Building with the Palestinian flag with a demon's face appearing on it.
quote: he lit it up with the Palestinian flag
falsify_match: The Empire State Building lit with the Palestinian flag at the mayor's instance.
falsify_miss: No such lighting. The building is privately owned and its lighting requests are decided by the owners, not the mayor.

claim_text: He and his son work out on air which flag it was, ruling out Iran, Ireland and Scotland and settling on something like the Mexican flag but striped, and then he sees a new industrial revolution and a great shaking of the nation with a storm, and Niagara Falls.
quote: that's kind of like the Mexico flag, but it was striped
falsify_match: A flag matching that description flown on the building.
falsify_miss: The identification is assembled on air by elimination, which is worth recording since the flag is the whole content.

claim_text: Niagara Falls full of debris, trash and dirty water with bicycle parts and tennis rackets floating down it as if from a flood or storm damage, with great darkness over it, seen while looking at Canada.
quote: Niagara Falls was full of debris and trash and dirt water
falsify_match: Flood debris on that scale in the Niagara river.
falsify_miss: No such flooding. The debris is his image for the state of Canada as much as a physical event.

claim_text: Freedom of speech to be greatly tested in Britain, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Italy and across Europe, and the mayor's action to be all over the news with little outcry against it, showing the heart of New York.
quote: these things are going to be tested greatly in the days ahead
falsify_match: Speech prosecutions rising across the named countries.
falsify_miss: No rise. Britain already prosecutes speech offences in numbers, which makes it the least distinguishing case.

claim_text: He is told that so freely the First Amendment will be lost, that losing the first strips away the rest, that people will fight hard for the Second while giving up the First, and that the First is more important than the Second.
quote: The first amendment is more important than the second amendment
falsify_match: Speech restrictions enacted while gun rights are defended successfully.
falsify_miss: Neither happens. This is the clearest statement of the ordering he sees between the two amendments.

claim_text: Major suppression coming in the next two years with fact checkers squashing people and persecution for saying certain things, including hate crime charges, with major countries and Israel involved, and an instruction to the church to say what needs saying from the pulpit.
quote: major suppression. Don't you dare say that
falsify_match: Prosecutions of preachers for pulpit speech in America within two years.
falsify_miss: No such prosecutions by April 2028. The two year bound makes this scoreable, which most of the speech material is not.

claim_text: He compares an image his son finds on screen to the demon he saw, rejecting a happier looking one, and says it will be celebrated in New York in the days ahead and viewers will see it on the news soon.
quote: you'll see that on the news soon
falsify_match: That image appearing publicly in New York.
falsify_miss: It does not. He is matching the vision against pictures found on screen, which fixes the detail after the fact.

claim_text: An abundance of rain called in over the land with authority taken over drought in Oklahoma, Texas, Kansas, Missouri, Alabama, Mississippi, Tennessee, North Carolina and Georgia.
quote: I hear the sound of an abundance of rain over the land
falsify_match: Drought breaking across those nine states.
falsify_miss: Drought persists. Nine states named at once means partial rain somewhere is guaranteed.

claim_text: Crops and corn coming up all over Tennessee as the rain is called in, with spiritual growth alongside.
quote: I see the corn coming up all over
falsify_match: An unusually good Tennessee corn season.
falsify_miss: An ordinary or poor one. Corn grows in Tennessee every year, which is the baseline problem.

claim_text: Prayer over the military with a greater war being attempted, and Cuba seen, with an explanation that he is moving from declaration into a different realm of intercession.
quote: It is a try to be a greater war
falsify_match: A wider war involving American forces around Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. The passage is mostly about his method of praying rather than content.

claim_text: Revival declared over the churches with bells ringing, then witchcraft and pride and darkness seen over Cuba to be dealt with again, with a wave of glory coming over Cuba and a statement that Cuba will be saved, alongside American troops.
quote: Cuba will be saved. Cuba will be saved
falsify_match: A religious movement in Cuba following an American military presence.
falsify_miss: Neither. Cuba appears in this corpus in both registers, as a threat and as a revival, which is worth keeping side by side.

claim_text: The middle class hurt by gas prices, food prices, inflation, housing and retirement, with 401ks taking a big hit, and the boomers who put Trump in not turning out to vote, with no rally and no war cry anymore.
quote: I see them not even getting out to vote
falsify_match: Depressed older turnout in the 2026 midterms.
falsify_miss: Older turnout holds up. Turnout among over-65s is the most stable in American politics, which makes this a real prediction against the base rate.

claim_text: Factory workers seen in Missouri with big layoffs coming to those factories, something wrong, and a repeated phrase that the attempt to turn it around is too little too late.
quote: I see big factory layoffs trying to come
falsify_match: Mass layoffs at Missouri manufacturers.
falsify_miss: Employment holds. Naming one state makes this checkable against state-level layoff notices.

claim_text: The new man at the Fed trying to bring rates down by a quarter point, with the words too broke and too hot repeated, and the man looking at the real books for the first time.
quote: I see the new guy trying to raise down 2.5 point 25%
falsify_match: A quarter point cut by Powell's successor with inflation described as too hot.
falsify_miss: A different move, or no successor yet. A quarter point is the standard increment, which limits how much the number distinguishes.

claim_text: Prayer for the stirring seen as a dove with an olive branch over what is about to happen with Cuba and the troops, for the vote to be too big to rig, and Jerome Powell seen gone, reluctantly.
quote: I see Jerome gone. Reluctantly
falsify_match: Powell leaving office unwillingly.
falsify_miss: He serves out his term and leaves normally. His term as chair ends in May 2026, which is weeks after this was given.

claim_text: Hardened hearts by design in the two men at the meeting, and justice coming for the Christians of Iran who have been slaughtered and tortured, given as eight young women face hanging the next day, which the president is publicly pleading against.
quote: I saw a a justice coming to the Christians of Iran
falsify_match: An identifiable reckoning for the Iranian authorities over religious persecution.
falsify_miss: None. The executions he refers to were being reported that day; his wife told him about them.

claim_text: He describes the women as facing execution for breaking Sharia dress rules, calls the culture pathetic, and says justice is knocking at the door for Iran in the days ahead.
quote: justice is coming justice is here justice is knocking
falsify_match: Regime accountability in Iran.
falsify_miss: None. Justice knocking at the door carries no content that could fail.

claim_text: He raises the objection that striking the Iranian power grid and water would kill ninety million people, then describes seeing a nuclear device, a white rocket with a ball at the front.
quote: That'll be 90 million people that pass away
falsify_match: An attack on Iranian infrastructure with mass civilian deaths.
falsify_miss: No such attack. Iran's population is about ninety million, so the figure he uses is the whole country.

claim_text: The mountain holding the nuclear enrichment breached by a MOAB-style device that makes a hole, after which something goes inside and makes it uninhabitable, done not by America but by Israel with American help, because the generals would not back it, and greater antisemitism rising from Turkey and Pakistan because of it.
quote: It wasn't America that did it. It was it was Israel
falsify_match: An Israeli strike making the enrichment site uninhabitable, with American assistance but not American authorship.
falsify_miss: No strike, or an American one. The division of responsibility is stated twice in two days, which makes it a settled part of the claim rather than a slip.

claim_text: He reads the Chronicles passage about the throne being established if the king walks as David walked, and about being plucked up by the roots if the people turn away and serve other gods.
quote: then will I pluck them up from the roots out of my land
falsify_match: Not applicable; scripture read aloud.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He says the prayers are producing results because the president is reading the Bible and talking about it on camera despite the mockery, which he calls fruit and a turnaround.
quote: He's he's reading the Bible and he's talking about it on camera
falsify_match: A durable change in the president's public religious practice.
falsify_miss: The practice stops or proves occasional. This is offered as the fruit of the praying president word, which makes it the first partial return on it.

claim_text: He points to a presidential post counting ten refineries in twenty one days across four continents, and says that while in intercession the previous night he saw another Russian oil rig being attacked and it happened right after.
quote: I see another oil oil rig being attacked in Russia as we speak
falsify_match: A timestamped recording of the call preceding the report.
falsify_miss: The live stream timing would need checking against the incident time. Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries were running at several a week in this period, which makes a hit likely on any given night.

claim_text: A global shaking of oil coming, with 1970s style gas lines and cars queuing for a mile unable to get fuel in some states, and he notes the vice president calling off a Pakistan trip after Iran refused to negotiate as the hardened heart.
quote: I saw 1970s oil lines, oil gas lines, cars, mile line
falsify_match: Fuel queues of that length in American states.
falsify_miss: No queues. The 1970s lines followed rationing and an embargo rather than a price rise, which is the condition that would have to return.

claim_text: The mountain to glow soon, Iranian oil wells completely destroyed, Saudi Arabia taking certain places as plunder, a liberation coming, and another regime change in Iran with a grey-haired bald man he keeps seeing and is told to pray for.
quote: We're going to have another regime change
falsify_match: A second Iranian leadership change with a bald grey-haired figure emerging.
falsify_miss: No further change. He says this one has already changed, so a second is the claim.

claim_text: A warning that the church is exalting a man and that God will not share his glory, with an account of a healing minister who was warned, began saying he was Elijah, and died in a car accident coming home from Amarillo.
quote: I'm looking at my church and how they are exalting a man
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; a warning about pride in ministry.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The cautionary example is drawn from an earlier generation of the movement.

claim_text: He says the church will be held accountable for praying for the president, notes he is criticised for supporting Israel, distinguishes the Jewish people from the Israeli government, and says a strategic attack is coming against Netanyahu's life with an election due for him this year or next.
quote: I saw a strategic attack coming against his life
falsify_match: An assassination attempt on Netanyahu.
falsify_miss: No attempt. He names the election as the reason to pray for whoever wins, which hedges the personal claim.

claim_text: He clarifies that he never said the New York man would be president, only that they are grooming him as a bigger voice for the Democrats with something demonic making him louder, and names him and Obama as Muslims.
quote: they're grooming him to be a bigger voice piece
falsify_match: The New York mayor becoming a national Democratic figure.
falsify_miss: He stays local. The clarification is worth recording because it narrows an earlier claim rather than widening it.

claim_text: Tractors seen across the nation, with prayer for Taiwan, for chips and for Japan and the Sooners, and a statement that the earthquake is only the beginning of the birthing pains and there will be much more.
quote: I believe, is just the beginning
falsify_match: A sequence of larger earthquakes following the recent one.
falsify_miss: Seismicity returns to normal. Just the beginning is the standard framing that keeps a thread open.

claim_text: Prayer that the eight young women be liberated and not hanged, that God appear to them in their cells, and that the people of Iran be liberated in a greater fashion.
quote: execute eight young women for really no need
falsify_match: The executions being halted.
falsify_miss: They proceed. Dated to the day, so it can be checked against Iranian execution reporting for that week.

claim_text: Closing prayer thanking God for showing what is to come, promising to deliver it with great detail and accuracy, and saying they are running out of time with Jesus standing at the door.
quote: with great detail and accuracy we will deliver what you tell us
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition about his own accuracy.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though accuracy is the standard he sets for himself here.

claim_text: Prayer over every governor's race and over Oklahoma, Texas, Florida, Louisiana and especially California, calling a red wave over California in the House and Senate with corrupt politicians voted out and new leaders raised up.
quote: We call a red wave over California
falsify_match: Republican gains in California in the 2026 midterms.
falsify_miss: California returns its usual delegation. Framed as a petition, though it names the state and the chambers.

claim_text: Prayer that Pelosi, Schumer and Newsom be retired soon and put in their resignations, with new voices raised up with a backbone like a crowbar, extended to South Korea and Taiwan.
quote: Nancy Pelosi is going to be retired soon
falsify_match: All three leaving office.
falsify_miss: Pelosi announced in November 2025 that she would not seek re-election, so that leg was already public; Schumer and Newsom are the open ones.

claim_text: Prayer that Kim Jong-un be removed even in the middle of the night along with his sister and the whole dynasty, so that North Koreans can worship freely, with people translated through supernatural highways and great revival there.
quote: your tyrant sister be removed in the name of Jesus
falsify_match: The dynasty ending.
falsify_miss: It continues. Framed as a petition here rather than as the belief he states elsewhere.

claim_text: Prayer over the genocide of Christians in Nigeria and elsewhere in Africa, said to be wiping them out by the hundreds of thousands, that the bloodshed stop and the hand of the Lord be against those doing it, and liberation and revival called over Cuba.
quote: the genocide of Christian they're just they're wiping them out
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition about an ongoing situation.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. Killings of Christians in Nigeria are documented in the thousands per year rather than hundreds of thousands.

claim_text: People relocating to Oklahoma, Texas, Kansas and Missouri and leaving the east this summer, seen with the sun setting in the west on the leaves, which he reads as the dispensation of grace ending and the tribulation about to begin.
quote: They were leaving a lot of the east this summer
falsify_match: An unusual migration out of the eastern states in summer 2026.
falsify_miss: Migration stays at ordinary rates. A season is given here, which makes this the dated version of the corridor claim.

claim_text: The Empire State Building lit up again with what he now identifies as the Iranian flag, with a demon face on it, grey with eyes on the building, and green, black and red seen.
quote: It's the Iranian flag
falsify_match: The building lit in Iranian colours.
falsify_miss: No such lighting. He identified it as Palestinian the previous day and as Iranian here, which is a change in the named flag.

claim_text: The face on the flag described as a demonic false god, grey with a red tongue, eyes and sharp teeth, with him and his son comparing versions of the Iranian emblem on screen and settling that it is a devil face rather than the lion or the standard one.
quote: Gray with a red tongue and eyes, sharp teeth
falsify_match: That emblem displayed in New York.
falsify_miss: It is not. The identification is settled by comparing images on screen during the broadcast.

claim_text: He asks why Epstein is standing next to Ginsburg given that both are dead, and sees the muscular man in New York sitting behind his desk again.
quote: Why is Epstein Epstein next to There are two dead peoples
falsify_match: Not checkable; he identifies both figures as dead himself.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because he raises the objection to his own vision on air.

claim_text: Canada's bill of rights about to be changed for the worse as an overreach, with the same for England and France and across Europe as they embrace what is on the building, and the New York mayor overreaching from his desk.
quote: Canada is about to be that changed. I see change
falsify_match: Amendment of the Canadian Charter narrowing expression.
falsify_miss: No amendment. The Charter requires provincial ratification, which makes change slow and visible.

claim_text: A plate dividing the First and Second Amendments, with a black steel plate protecting the Second while the black widow cocoons the First, and the word that it will be stripped away while people fight hardest for the Second without realising they are being silenced.
quote: So freely you will give the first, but you'll fight for the second
falsify_match: Speech restrictions passing while gun rights hold.
falsify_miss: Neither. The image is consistent across two nights, which makes it one of the stable ones.

claim_text: A chiselling away grain by grain so that as one goes they all go, with the web wrapping tighter around the First Amendment to choke it out, and an instruction to watch the Supreme Court and to fight for freedoms in Canada and Europe.
quote: It will be a chiseling away
falsify_match: An incremental narrowing of speech protection traceable through court decisions.
falsify_miss: No narrowing. Chiselling away rather than a single event means almost any ruling could be fitted to it.
